RuleDescription: If MoldCodeNorm exists, RequestLetterNo is blank, and WorkDate falls inside exactly one existing proposed RepairCase date range for the same MoldCode, classify as SAME_CASE_CANDIDATE for human review; do not auto-assign in v2 yet.
Notes: Business confirmation required before automatic assignment.

RuleDescription: If MoldCodeNorm exists, RequestLetterNo is blank, and WorkDate occurs 1-3 days after the end of one existing proposed RepairCase for the same MoldCode, classify as CONTINUATION_CANDIDATE for human review.
Notes: Do not automatically merge; delayed data entry and new case are both possible.

RuleDescription: If MoldCodeNorm exists, RequestLetterNo is blank, no existing proposed Case reasonably covers the date, and repair-like records form a close temporal cluster, classify as NEW_CASE_CANDIDATE.
Notes: Cluster window to be finalized with business review.

RuleDescription: If MoldCodeNorm exists, RequestLetterNo is blank, and the nearest existing proposed Case is separated by more than 3 days, classify as NEW_OR_REOPENED_CASE_CANDIDATE.
Notes: Requires business review; time gap alone must not create a Case.

RuleDescription: Repair-like records with blank MoldCode must not receive an automatic RepairCase assignment; route them to a dedicated MissingMoldCode review queue.
SourceBasis: RepairCase v1 logic: 430 excluded repair-like records
Notes: Do not infer MoldCode from MoldName, ProductTechnicalNo, MachineCode or PartCode.

RuleDescription: WorkDate proximity may support review classification but must not be the sole basis for final RepairCase assignment.
Notes: Final assignment should use RequestLetterNo, MoldCode, business context and traceability evidence where available.
